User.title: User Profile
User.description: Information about a user, including their system role and metadata.

id.description: The authentication UID of the user.

role.description: The system role of the user determining access level.

Project.title: Project Event
Project.description: An event or project containing collections of photos.

id.description: The unique ID of the project.

date.description: Date when the event took place.

coverUrl.description: A preview cover photo for the project.

Photo.title: Event Photo
Photo.description: An image uploaded by a photographer associated with an event.

id.description: A unique ID for the photo.

projectId.description: The ID of the project event this photo belongs to.

base64Data.description: The high definition base64 encoded photo content.

uploaderId.description: UID of the staff member who uploaded it.

SystemSetting.title: System Setting
SystemSetting.description: General settings of the Snap AI workspace, such as watermark overlay configs.

logoBase64.description: Watermark logo base64 image representation, if uploaded

users/{userId}.description: User profile with role permission levels.

photos/{photoId}.description: High resolution photos associated with project events.

settings/{settingId}.description: Workplace general configurations and watermark images.
